connector.name: Xbird
connector.registryDescription: Twitter/X MCP server - 30 tools with x402 micropayments. Runs locally from your IP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package xbird-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the checkra1neth account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: XBIRD_PRIVATE_KEY
